mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_level_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} AND level_id = #{levelId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_level_progress (id, user_id, level_id, status, score, stars, completion_percentage, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{levelId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{status, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.ProgressStatusHandler}, #{score}, #{stars}, #{completionPercentage}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
